descriptionTemplate: Grok as a peer implementer for {{host}}: default integration=direct lands live-tree edits for one-shot code (no consent gate); auto/review are opt-in worktrees; ACP peer is opt-in multi-turn (always external worktree; stop-time apply). runMode direct is a separate installed-home security posture. runMode.title: Run mode
runMode.description: Security posture (orthogonal to integration): hardened (default; private home + sandbox) or direct (installed Grok CLI / normal home). Not how edits land - see integrationMode and plugin/references/integration-modes.md.

integrationMode.title: Integration mode
integrationMode.description: How edits land (orthogonal to runMode): direct = product default live-tree (one-shot code; ACP peer stop-time apply after always-external worktree; no consent gate); auto/review = opt-in worktrees. userConfig is a hint only. SSOT: plugin/references/integration-modes.md.

notificationMode.title: Completion notifications
notificationMode.description: off, auto (background runs only), native, or webhook

interface.shortDescription: Peer implementer for Codex: live-tree code default, opt-in ACP peer, verified handoff
interface.longDescription: Grok as a peer implementer for Codex CLI and the ChatGPT desktop app. Product default is integration=direct: live-tree edits for one-shot code (no consent gate). Auto and review are opt-in isolated worktrees. ACP peer is opt-in multi-turn (always external worktree; apply only at ready peer-stop). runMode is a separate security axis: hardened (default private home + sandbox) vs runMode direct (installed Grok CLI / normal home). Codex agents install via setup; trusted SessionStart only reconciles owned files. Canonical matrix: plugin/references/integration-modes.md. Every mode emits exactly one machine-readable JSON result envelope. Not affiliated with xAI.
